verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents an official, first-party hosted MCP server, with a dedicated setup page and a list of supported AI clients (Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code with Copilot, Windsurf). Through it, agents can manage flags and AgentControl configs and view observability data in natural language. A probe confirms the official MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of real-world agent use of the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Configure the hosted MCP server so you can manage feature flags and AgentControl configs, and view observability data, directly from your AI client.
you must have an AI client that supports MCP, such as Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code with Copilot, or Windsurf.
To get started with the LaunchDarkly MCP server, you enable the server, then use it to manage flags, AgentControl configs, and observability data with natural language.
